title: 第一卷 第18章 踏入暗劲
novel_title: 津门武圣，从苦力开始每日结算
content_zh:
镇涛堂今晚灯火通明。

    几百号光膀子的汉子，划拳声、喝酒声、吹牛声，几乎要把房顶掀翻。

    陆川坐在主位，手里端着大碗酒，神色淡然。

    底下，原本的堂主裘然，此刻正腆着一张老脸，满脸堆笑地凑过来。

    “陆哥，这杯酒兄弟敬您！”

    “之前是兄弟有眼不识泰山，您大人有大量，别跟我这老糊涂计较。”

    裘然今年快五十了，比陆川大了一轮不止。

    此刻却一口一个“哥”叫着，腰弯得恨不得把头塞进裤裆里。

    陆川看了他一眼，没说话，仰头干了碗中酒。

    “好！”

    “陆哥豪爽！”

    裘然大喜过望，激动得脸都红了。

    周围的小弟们哄堂大笑，气氛热烈到了极点。

    没人觉得裘然丢人。

    在这个世道，拳头大就是哥。

    陆川一拳把裘然干服了，又一脚踹飞了帮主亲儿子，连帮主赵海柱都对他客客气气。

    这还不叫哥，难道等以后叫爹？

    吴先生喝得满脸通红，站在桌子上，唾沫横飞地吹嘘。

    “你们是没看见！”

    “当时那场面，陆爷手持轻机枪，那是神挡杀神，佛挡杀佛！”

    “青帮那个李三爷，平时多横啊？见到陆爷，腿都软了，跪在地上喊爷爷！”

    “哒哒哒！那轻机枪一响，青帮那帮孙子跟割麦子一样倒一片！”

    底下的帮众听得热血沸腾，一个个嗷嗷乱叫。

    “陆爷威武！”

    “干死青帮！”

    陆川听着吴先生的胡吹乱侃，嘴角微微抽搐。

    轻机枪是他开的，但李三爷可是被他一棍子干死的，哪来的跪地求饶。

    不过无所谓，士气可用就行。

    这顿酒喝到晚上九点多。

    大部分人已经喝高了，东倒西歪地躺在地上。

    就在这时。

    “砰！砰！砰！”

    外面突然传来一阵急促的枪声。

    紧接着是喊杀声和惨叫声。

    “敌袭！青帮杀进来了！”

    “兄弟们抄家伙！”

    原本喧闹的堂口瞬间炸了锅。

    醉汉们瞬间清醒了一半，慌乱地去找枪。

    裘然脸色一变，刚想喊人组织防御。

    一道黑影已经从他身边掠过。

    陆川单手提起靠在柱子上的精铁长棍，大步流星往外走。

    “慌什么！”

    “来了正好！”

    “今晚就拿青帮的人头下酒！”

    陆川的声音不大，却透着一股子令人安心的冷硬。

    原本慌乱的帮众们，见副堂主如此淡定，心下稍安。

    “对！怕个球！”

    “跟陆爷干！”

    “剁了青帮杂碎的脑袋下酒！”

    “杀啊！”

    众人吼叫着，跟着陆川冲出了大门。

    门外，火光冲天。

    上百十号青帮汉子，手持砍刀棍棒，正疯狂冲击镇涛堂的大门。

    “给我杀！一个不留！”

    领头的刀疤脸嘶吼着，挥舞大刀砍翻了一个冲出来的海河帮众。

    然而，下一秒。

    他的吼声戛然而止。

    因为他看到了一道死神般的身影。

    陆川！

    没有废话，没有叫阵。

    陆川一步踏出，手中精铁长棍带着呼啸的风声，横扫千军。

    “呼——啪！”

    冲在最前面的三个青帮汉子，连惨叫都没发出来，直接被这一棍子抽飞。

    胸骨塌陷，身体像破布袋一样飞出十几米远，落地就没了声息。

    一招，秒杀三人！

    “陆爷威武！”

    “陆爷威武！”

    后面的海河帮众见陆川如此神勇，酒劲瞬间化作了杀气。

    “杀啊！”

    “干死这帮孙子！”

    双方瞬间绞杀在一起。

    陆川一马当先，长棍在他手中如同一条出海蛟龙。

    扫、砸、挑、刺。

    每一棍下去，必有一人骨断筋折。

    鲜血飞溅，染红了他的衣衫，却让他看起来更加如同魔神降世。

    “机枪！把机枪抬出来！”

    混乱中，吴先生那尖细的嗓音响起。
content_en:
Zhentao Hall is brightly lit tonight.

    Hundreds of shirtless men, the sound of punching, drinking, and bragging, almost brought down the roof.

    Lu Chuan was sitting at the main seat, holding a large bowl of wine in his hand and looking indifferent.

    Below, Qiu Ran, the original hall master, was approaching with a shy old face and a smile on his face.

    "Brother Lu, this glass of wine is for you!"

    "Before, my brother was too blind to see the truth. You, sir, have a lot. Don't argue with me, an old fool."

    Qiu Ran is almost fifty this year and is more than a round older than Lu Chuan.

    At this moment, he was shouting "Brother" one after another, bending over so hard that he wanted to stuff his head into his crotch.

    Lu Chuan glanced at him, said nothing, and raised his head to drink the wine from the bowl.

    "Okay!"

    "Brother Lu is so generous!"

    Qiu Ran was overjoyed and turned red with excitement.

    The boys around burst into laughter, and the atmosphere was extremely lively.

    No one felt that Qiu Ran was embarrassed.

    In this world, the person with the big fist is the elder brother.

    Lu Chuan knocked Qiu Ran down with one punch and kicked away the gang leader's own son. Even the gang leader Zhao Haizhu was polite to him.

    If you don't call me brother yet, why don't you call me father later?

    Mr. Wu, his face flushed from drinking, stood on the table, spitting and boasting.

    "You didn't see it!"

    "In that scene, Mr. Lu was holding a light machine gun. It was a god blocking a god, and a Buddha blocking a Buddha!"

    "How arrogant is Mr. Li San from the Qing Gang? When he saw Mr. Lu, his legs went weak. He knelt on the ground and called me grandpa!"

    "Da da da! When the light machine gun fired, the young men of the Qing Gang fell into pieces like wheat!"

    The crowd below heard it with excitement, and they all howled and screamed.

    "Master Lu is mighty!"

    "Kill the Qing Gang!"

    Lu Chuan's mouth twitched slightly as he listened to Mr. Wu's nonsense.

    He was the one who fired the light machine gun, but Mr. Li Sanye was killed by him with a stick. How could he kneel down and beg for mercy?

    But it doesn’t matter, as long as the morale is available.

    We drank until about nine o'clock in the evening.

    Most of the people were already drunk and lying on the ground.

    Just then.

    "Bang! Bang! Bang!"

    Suddenly there was a burst of rapid gunfire outside.

    This was followed by shouts of death and screams.

    "Enemy attack! The Green Gang is coming!"

    "Brothers copy the guy!"

    The originally noisy hall suddenly exploded.

    The drunkards suddenly sobered up half-consciously and started looking for guns in a panic.

    Qiu Ran's expression changed and he was about to call someone to organize a defense.

    A black shadow had passed by him.

    Lu Chuan picked up the fine iron rod leaning against the pillar with one hand and strode out.

    "Why panic!"

    "It's just in time!"

    “I’ll drink the heads of the Qing Gang tonight!”

    Lu Chuan's voice was not loud, but it contained a reassuring coldness.

    The originally panicked gang members felt a little at ease when they saw the deputy hall leader being so calm.

    "Yes! Afraid of a ball!"

    "Fuck Master Lu!"

    "Chop off the heads of the gangsters and drink them!"

    "Kill!"

    Everyone roared and rushed out of the gate with Lu Chuan.

    Outside the door, flames shot into the sky.

    Hundreds of Green Gang men, armed with machetes and sticks, were frantically attacking the gate of Zhentao Hall.

    "Kill me! Leave no one behind!"

    The leader, Scarface, roared and wielded his machete to chop down a Haihe gang member who rushed out.

    However, the next second.

    His roar stopped abruptly.

    Because he saw a death-like figure.

    Lu Chuan!

    No nonsense, no shouting.

    Lu Chuan took one step forward, sweeping through thousands of troops with the long fine iron stick in his hand carrying the whistling sound of the wind.

    "Whoops!"

    The three Qing Gang men who were at the front were whipped away by the stick without even letting out a scream.

    The sternum collapsed, and the body flew more than ten meters away like a rag bag, and made no sound when it landed on the ground.

    Kill three people instantly with one move!

    "Master Lu is mighty!"

    "Master Lu is mighty!"

    Seeing how brave Lu Chuan was, everyone in the Haihe Gang behind them instantly turned to murderous intent.

    "Kill!"

    "Kill these grandsons to death!"

    The two sides instantly strangled each other.

    Lu Chuan took the lead, and the long stick in his hand was like a dragon rising out of the sea.

    Sweep, smash, pick, stab.

    Every time the stick goes down, one person's bones will be broken and his tendons will be broken.

    The blood spattered and dyed his clothes red, making him look even more like a demon god coming to the world.

    "Machine gun! Bring out the machine gun!"

    In the chaos, Mr. Wu’s high-pitched voice sounded.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 18 Stepping into Dark Power
